summary.en: An accelerating charge — in the simplest case, one oscillating back and forth like a dipole antenna — radiates electromagnetic waves whose intensity is not the same in every direction: it is zero along the dipole's own axis and greatest in the plane perpendicular to it, following a sin²θ pattern with θ measured from that axis.
summary.et: Kiirendusega laeng — lihtsaimal juhul selline, mis võngub edasi-tagasi nagu dipoolantenn — kiirgab elektromagnetlaineid, mille intensiivsus ei ole igas suunas sama: see on null mööda dipooli oma telge ja suurim sellega risti oleval tasandil, järgides sin²θ mustrit, kus θ mõõdetakse sellest teljest.
